message: No detected input validation: The code reads 'cleaned_data.csv' directly with pd.read_csv without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local CSV file path with no remote fetch, so no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks are applicable or present.
No detected label flipping detection: The code simply reads a CSV and displays/uses it without any label distribution checks, validation against expected label sets, or label-noise detection tools.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is performed on the data before it is used for modeling.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded; models are trained in-memory (KMeans, RandomForestRegressor, GaussianMixture) with no hash checks or signature verification.
No detected label distribution validation: No label distribution checks, class balance validation, or anomalous sample detection are present in the code before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor or trigger detection mechanism such as activation analysis, neural cleanse, or gradient anomaly detection in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code does not implement any held-out test set isolation, data hashing/signing, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation; evaluation metrics are referenced only in UI text (e.g., '73% accuracy') without any formal evaluation pipeline.
No detected input sanitization: User inputs from sliders and selectboxes are passed directly to pandas/sklearn without any shape, range, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range predictions, or probability sanity bounds before displaying results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML models (RandomForest, KMeans, GMM), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
